duration: IT approvals are not timed installation promises
cost: Licences and available disk/network must be approved
summary: Phase 0 comes before scripts. Keep a new or existing clone safe, review corporate routing and separate repository readiness from laptop acceptance.

purpose.p: Make prerequisites and human decisions visible before setup.
This guide does not install Git/VS Code, authenticate, update another clone, change policy or infer machine readiness from CI.

starting_state.p: Supported serviced Windows 11 build 22621 or later, virtualization/nested virtualization as applicable, at least 15 GB free plus SDK/image/distro budgets, approved UAC/licensing/restart window.

App Installer/WinGet registered for the signed-in user, approved CLI/configuration/source routing, network/proxy/TLS/Authenticode and script execution policy. Git/VS Code and private-repo access must already be available before cloning.

steps.title: Confirm actual prerequisites with IT

ul: Review Windows service/build support, virtualization, disk budgets and approved tool/licence choices.
Confirm App Installer/WinGet source/configuration support, approved corporate proxy/TLS and extension CLI/default-profile routing.
Confirm private GitHub access and a Copilot entitlement separately; neither setup nor Verify signs you in.

steps.expect: Explicit approved decisions or a prerequisite blocker, not permission to work around policy.

steps.title: Inspect effective script policy without changing it

body.p: All scopes Undefined can still resolve to Restricted. If blocked, record the script check NOT RUN and inspect source/mocks. Only a human, after explicit IT approval for an unset/default restriction, may consider the documented CurrentUser RemoteSigned route. It is not a Group Policy/AllSigned bypass.

callout.text: No agent policy change, process/child-shell override, Bypass, blanket unblock, elevation or restart. Retain imposed controls.

steps.expect: All scopes and effective policy understood; no machine/user/process policy changed.

steps.title: Clone and review Workspace Trust
steps.where: VS Code › Source Control › Clone Repository

ol: Use Source Control: Clone Repository, or Ctrl+Shift+P: Git: Clone, with the authorized private repository URL.
Choose your own approved new folder; open it only after source review.
Review README, AGENTS.md, .github instructions and Workspace Trust. Trust is a decision, not automatic permission to run tasks.

steps.expect: A separately reviewed checkout. Never modify the user's primary clone or another active session as a demo shortcut.

steps.title: For an existing clone, update only when safe
steps.where: Save work › Source Control › Reviewed incoming main

ol: Wait for setup/resume, app/test/Restore tasks and agent edits to finish; save all unsaved editor work.
Inspect status, branch, approved remote and incoming source. If dirty/shared/active, use a separate reviewed checkout instead.
Only a clean reviewed main can be explicitly updated fast-forward; do not reset, auto-stash, discard files or switch someone else's active branch.

steps.expect: Preserved staged, unstaged, untracked and unsaved work, with actual source identity reviewed.

expected.p: A supported, approved starting state and safely reviewed source checkout. This is not a claim that runtime/extension setup is complete.

success.p: Confirm every prerequisite/approval; then choose [Preflight](page:setup-preflight). Save actual observed results separately from this guide's ticks.

failures.cause: Effective Restricted, AllSigned or imposed policy
failures.fix: Report NOT RUN; inspect source and ask IT through approved processes. Never bypass the imposed policy.

failures.symptom: Existing clone is dirty or still running tasks
failures.fix: Retain everything; wait or use a separate reviewed clean checkout. Do not switch/reset/update it.

failures.symptom: Private marketplace or GitHub access is uncertain
failures.fix: Stop acceptance and obtain supported IT-managed delivery/access. No public VSIX, account/profile/source workaround.

recovery.p: Use [non-destructive recovery](page:operate-recovery). Missing approval is a blocker, not permission to repair/install or use the legacy bundle.

limitations.p: The page and existing hosted CI do not inspect this laptop, effective profile, credentials, virtualization state or disk.

say: Prerequisites come before scripts, and IT policy stays intact.
I preserve the active clone and all unrelated work.
Repository CI and laptop acceptance are different evidence.
evidence_gaps: No live laptop prerequisites, GitHub sign-in, effective extension profile or source-routing acceptance were observed by the companion.
